note: 28-acre family campground on Campground Rd in Penn Run, Indiana County, ~3 mi from Yellow Creek State Park; roughly 175 full-hookup (water/electric/sewer, 50-amp) sites including pull-thrus, plus open-field and wooded tent sites and a rental cabin, camp store, 24/7 heated bathhouse, laundry, dump station, pool/fishing, mini golf, playground, pavilion and planned activities. Nightly, monthly and seasonal sites are all offered, and the operator says the campground is open year round. Reserve by phone; the Hipcamp listing is still marked 'coming soon' and is not bookable. The grounds are seasonal-heavy -- reviews and satellite show permanent trailers through the north loops -- with the transient sites in the open double rows on the south side. RV Life 5*/$$ ~$33/night (auto 9/2026). --Claude
summary: Confirmed fees $32/$35, 175 sites with pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/laundry/camp store. Changed season from derived Apr 15-Oct 31 to year-round (operator: 'The campground is open year round'), and corrected the note's season sentence.
